sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: Introduction Physics contributed to the birth of knot theory in the 19th century, when Lord Kelvin hypothesized that atoms are knotted vortices of aether [1]. Although the idea was doomed to fail,1 it is said to inspire the first knot classification by Peter Guthrie Tait. sections.extract: Topological Tangling and Quantum Entanglement Quantum entanglement is a property of quantum mechanical systems quantified by correlations. sections.extract: Dense Coding Superdense, or, simply, dense coding is a protocol closely related to quantum teleportation.
